installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# NodeJS App Installation Script
apt update
apt install -y git curl jq file unzip make gcc g++ python3 libtool

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ -n "${GIT_URL}" ]; then
    if [[ ${GIT_URL} != *.git ]]; then
        GIT_URL=${GIT_URL%/} 
        GIT_URL=${GIT_URL}.git
    fi

    if [ -z "${USERNAME}" ] && [ -z "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
        echo -e "using anon api call"
    else
        GIT_URL="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo -e ${GIT_URL} | cut -d/ -f3-)"
    fi

    if [ ! "$(ls -A /mnt/server)" ]; then
        echo -e "cloning files into repo"
        if [ -z "${GIT_BRANCH}" ]; then
            git clone "${GIT_URL}" .
        else
            git clone --single-branch --branch "${GIT_BRANCH}" "${GIT_URL}" .
        fi
    fi
fi

if [ -f /mnt/server/package.json ]; then
    corepack enable >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    PM_CHOICE=${PACKAGE_MANAGER:-auto}

    if [ "${PM_CHOICE}" = "auto" ]; then
        if [ -f /mnt/server/pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then
            PM_CHOICE=pnpm
        elif [ -f /mnt/server/yarn.lock ]; then
            PM_CHOICE=yarn
        else
            PM_CHOICE=npm
        fi
    fi

    echo -e "using package manager: ${PM_CHOICE}"

    if [ "${PM_CHOICE}" = "pnpm" ]; then
        if [ -f /mnt/server/pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then
            pnpm install --prod --frozen-lockfile
        else
            pnpm install --prod
        fi
    elif [ "${PM_CHOICE}" = "yarn" ]; then
        yarn install --production=true
    else
        if [ -f /mnt/server/package-lock.json ] || [ -f /mnt/server/npm-shrinkwrap.json ]; then
            /usr/local/bin/npm ci --omit=dev
        else
            /usr/local/bin/npm install --omit=dev
        fi
    fi
fi

echo -e "install complete"
exit 0
